article.title: Inside Israel’s ‘soft’ ethnic cleansing plan for Gaza through the eyes of its victims
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: Through embassy evacuations, academic fellowships, and WHO medical corridors, Palestinians are leaving Gaza in small but steady numbers. Israeli officials call it "voluntary migration," but the Gazans forced to leave know it's part of Israel's plan.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
